name: markdown_wrapping
description: Wrap literal words with canonical Markdown bold, italic, inline-code or strikethrough syntax. Control repeats the literal word without formatting.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
styles={'bold':'**','italic':'*','inline code':'`','strikethrough':'~~'}
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 style=list(styles)[i%4];word=random.choice(['hello','world','sample','note','test','example','text','word']);mark=styles[style];p=f'Word: {word}. Requested Markdown style: {style}.\n'
 items.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the formatted word. Use asterisks for bold/italic, backticks for code, and tildes for strikethrough. Answer:','answer':' '+mark+word+mark})
 control.append({'prompt':p+'Write only the unformatted word, with no markup. Answer:','answer':' '+word})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
